topics.topic: Deterministic tie-breaking/order for selecting the first failure in A05 checks (including endpoint representation)
questions: When multiple conditions on the same node/edge fail at once, what is the deterministic sub-order of failure reasons within that phase item?
How are `from_node`/`to_node` represented and ordered when an endpoint is a flow input/output (not a node), so the "first failing edge" is deterministic?

topics.topic: How node conclusions are persisted/recovered when no NodeExecution record is written
questions: Where is this node-level success persisted/read from if no NodeExecution is written, given run-end logic depends on node conclusions?
How is this node conclusion persisted/recovered if no NodeExecution exists, especially across restart while run is still advancing?

topics.topic: Normative request-URL join/normalization algorithm and invalid/absolute path handling before send
questions: What exact URL-join and normalization algorithm is normative (slash handling, `..`, `//`, percent-encoding normalization), and what exactly counts as an "absolute path" here?
What exact URL-join and normalization algorithm is mandated (slash handling, dot-segments, encoded characters), and which path forms are invalid before send?

topics.topic: Required trapping behavior for implicit or alternate RNG constructors that introduce nondeterminism
questions: What is the required behavior for `random.Random()` or `random.Random(None)` (no explicit deterministic seed)?
How must calls that still create nondeterminism but are not explicitly listed be handled (for example `random.Random()` without an explicit seed, `random.SystemRandom`, or equivalent constructors)?

topics.topic: Definition of "same schema" in proof checks (canonical identity vs semantic equivalence)
questions: Does "same schema" mean byte-identical/canonical-JSON-equal schema documents, or semantic equivalence under the supported schema subset?

topics.topic: Deterministic order for recovering multiple `running` runs at startup
questions: In what order are multiple `running` runs recovered at startup, and is that order required to be deterministic?

topics.topic: Exact byte-count basis used for `output_bytes` limit/outcome evaluation
questions: What exact byte measure is compared to `output_bytes` for a function execution (especially with mixed `value` and `file` outputs, mapped outputs, and JSON encoding overhead)?

topics.topic: How startup verifies token randomness quality beyond mere presence/format
questions: How is "random" verified at startup beyond length/content presence?

topics.topic: How to classify/redact `failure_detail` text sourced from service error bodies
questions: How is disclosure class assigned to `failure_detail` text sourced from service error bodies when that text is not among named values/files?

topics.topic: Required installation-file ownership/mode/ACL checks, including handling of symlinked config paths
questions: What exact ownership and mode checks are required (owner uid, allowed modes like `0400`/`0600`, ACL handling, symlinked config path)?

topics.topic: Scope/timing of symlink refusal checks during runtime file access and post-startup changes
questions: Is symlink checking only at startup, or on every runtime file access (spool/value/fixture/temp), and what happens if a symlink appears after startup?

topics.topic: What metadata of `personal_data` file inputs may be exposed in approval/agent views
questions: For a file input classified `personal_data`, may an agent see `size` and `media_type`, or must it receive only digest+class?

topics.topic: Whether `draft-write` retries after `not_applied` must first obtain/wait for owner approval
questions: After a `draft-write` attempt is resolved `not_applied`, must the element now create/wait for an EffectApproval (`owner_approval`) before resend?

topics.topic: Whether a guard-only output counts as "reaching" under the phase-9 reachability check
questions: Does an output used only as a guard source (and never carried on an edge into an input) count as "reaches"?

topics.topic: Whether a pre-send failure still consumes an attempt number and creates a numbered NodeExecution attempt
questions: If pre-send checks fail before any request is sent, does that still consume an `attempt_number` and produce a numbered NodeExecution attempt?

topics.topic: Which NodeExecution statuses qualify as a "failed node" for upstream-failure propagation
questions: Which NodeExecution statuses count as a "failed node" for this rule (for example: `contract_violation`, `operation_refused`, `service_unreachable`, `outcome_unknown`, `refused_by_owner`)?
